messages:
elaine (sales): Customer POC hitting 403s on /v1/generate intermittently. Keys were handed out yesterday. Need eng help pls.
shane (sales-eng): can you paste the exact curl + error?
elaine (sales): they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXX-REDACTED' \n  -H 'X-Org-Id: org-acme-qa' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-8k","input":"hi"}'
```
response:
```
{"error":{"code":403,"message":"org id mismatch: token bound to org org-acme, request org header org-acme-qa"}}
```
elaine (sales): they also saw bursts of 429s during load tests.
shane (sales-eng): looks like two issues: auth binding mismatch + hitting trial rate limits. Maria, can you pull auth logs for that key?
maria (eng-oncall): @devops-bot get-auth-logs sk-prod-XXX-REDACTED last 30m
devops-bot: logs for token ending XXX-REDACTED:
2026-03-19T20:12:02Z AUTH FAIL token=sk-prod-XXX-REDACTED request_org=org-acme-qa token_org=org-acme reason=org_mismatch
2026-03-19T20:12:18Z AUTH SUCCESS token=sk-prod-XXX-REDACTED request_org=org-acme token_org=org-acme
2026-03-19T20:14:01Z RATE_LIMIT token=sk-prod-XXX-REDACTED reqs=220 window=60s limit=200

shane (sales-eng): confirms it. Likely they copied prod token into QA env and left X-Org-Id set to qa. Two remediation paths: 1) remove X-Org-Id header (we infer org from token) or 2) issue a QA-scoped token.
elaine (sales): customer says they need explicit header due to their proxy. Any short-term workaround?
maria (eng-oncall): short: create a token bound to org-acme-qa and give them that. Long term: request an entitlement to allow cross-org tokens but that's a security change and needs compliance review.
shane (sales-eng): also for the 429s we can temporarily increase demo quota. Elaine, want me to approve a bump for their scheduled stress run?
elaine (sales): yes, they plan a 10min test at 15:30 PT.
maria (eng-oncall): bump applied: demo quota raised to 500rps for 30m. Temp token issued id ends with -TMPQA, shared via secure channel.
acme-poc-contact: validated — 200s now, thank you. We hit ~480rps, saw a couple 503s when concurrency spiked, but looks good overall.
shane (sales-eng): notes for presales runbook: when you see `org id mismatch` check auth logs for request_org vs token_org and confirm header vs token pairing. For demo rate issues, temporarily bump quota or provision a dedicated reserved pool.
elaine (sales): thanks team, closing this POC ticket with customer. :tada:
